qualifier: ISG15 protein conjugation
name: ISG15 conjugation in interferon-stimulated antiviral defense
rationale: All three members describe ISG15 conjugation as an interferon-stimulated antiviral effector, whereas confusables cover upstream RIG-I/MDA5 sensing, IRF3/TBK1 activation and generic interferon signatures.

qualifier: IL-10, IL-27 and IL-35 signaling with IL-10/IL-12 production control
name: Immunosuppressive IL-10, IL-27 and IL-35 signaling and production control
rationale: Members are IL-10, IL-27 and IL-35 receptor signaling plus regulation of IL-10 production and suppression of IL-12, distinguishing it from confusables built on IL-12/IL-23, IL-17/Th17 and C-type lectin antifungal signaling.

qualifier: aldosterone- and renin-angiotensin-responsive renal context
name: Aldosterone-responsive renal sodium import regulation
rationale: Members concern control of plasma-membrane sodium import (with associated pH effects) in response to aldosterone and renal renin-angiotensin signals, whereas confusables emphasize angiotensin pressor signaling, potassium transport or calcium channel regulation.

qualifier: intestinal sterol absorption and canalicular ABC transporter defects
name: Bile acid synthesis, transport and intestinal sterol absorption
rationale: Members cover cholesterol-to-bile-acid synthesis, enterohepatic bile acid transport and signaling, ABCB/ABCG transporter defects and intestinal cholesterol/lipid absorption, distinguishing it from confusables focused on xenobiotic/bilirubin transport, lipoprotein assembly and cholesterol efflux.

qualifier: TGF-beta1 production and matrix degradation control
name: Fibrotic repair with TGF-beta1 production and matrix turnover control
rationale: Members regulate fibroblast differentiation/survival, connective tissue replacement, ECM assembly and disassembly, elastin breakdown and TGF-beta1 production; the TGF-beta1 production, MMP secretion and elastin/ECM disassembly members are what confusables (SMAD signaling, fibroblast migration, collagen metabolism) lack.

qualifier: 5' cap formation, decapping and snRNP biogenesis
name: mRNA capping, decapping decay and snRNP biogenesis
rationale: Members span cap formation, cap-dependent 5'-to-3' decay and decapping, snRNA cap hypermethylation/transport and snRNP/spliceosome assembly, which distinguishes them from confusables focused on polyadenylation, histone mRNA processing, mRNA export or rRNA/Pol I-III transcription.

qualifier: regulation of aldosterone and cortisol synthesis and secretion
name: Regulation of aldosterone and cortisol biosynthesis and secretion
rationale: Members regulate mineralocorticoid and glucocorticoid synthesis and aldosterone secretion, unlike confusables that list the CYP enzymatic steps and their defects, cortisol response/ACTH, or renal aldosterone effects.

qualifier: angiotensin signaling, blood volume and renal vascular resistance
name: Renin-angiotensin control of blood volume and arterial pressure
rationale: All members are angiotensin/renin-angiotensin mechanisms raising blood volume and systemic arterial pressure, whereas confusables cover vascular smooth muscle tone, NO/cGMP vasodilation or renal aldosterone-sodium handling.

qualifier: nucleoside-analog and thiopurine drug metabolism
name: Nucleoside triphosphate hydrolysis and nucleoside-analog drug metabolism
rationale: Members cover NUDT-mediated nucleotide pool sanitization and triphosphate catabolism plus metabolism of nucleoside-analog and thiopurine drugs (abacavir, ribavirin, azathioprine, TPMT methylation), which the de novo synthesis and salvage confusables lack.

qualifier: inhibitory GABAergic postsynapse with presynaptic release enhancement
name: Inhibitory synapse assembly and presynaptic release enhancement
rationale: Members combine gephyrin/GABA receptor clustering and inhibitory synapse assembly with enhanced vesicle exocytosis, short-term potentiation and LGI-ADAM synaptic organization, distinguishing them from excitatory NMDA/PSD-95 confusables and presynaptic G-protein/calcium channel modulation.

qualifier: TFAP2 transcription factor regulation
name: Hippo-YAP/TAZ signaling and TFAP2 transcription factor regulation
rationale: Members center on Hippo pathway regulation, YAP/TAZ-driven transcription and cell-density sensing, and uniquely include TFAP2 activation/inhibition, alternative splicing and a growth-factor-braking module absent from all confusables.

qualifier: nucleotide-sugar transport, GPI anchoring and glycosphingolipids
name: Nucleotide-sugar transport, GPI anchoring and glycosphingolipid synthesis
rationale: Members cover SLC35/SLC33 nucleotide-sugar transporter defects, GDP-fucose and UDP-glucuronate formation, GPI anchor synthesis/attachment and glycosphingolipid synthesis, whereas confusables focus on N-glycan, dolichol, sialic acid and UDP-GlcNAc metabolism.

qualifier: ferroptosis and mitochondrial respiration control
name: Peroxide-induced cell death, ferroptosis and mitochondrial respiration control
rationale: Members regulate hydrogen peroxide/hypoxia-driven apoptosis and ferroptosis together with oxidative phosphorylation and ATP synthesis; confusables have either the respiration side or the stress side but not both, or emphasize ROS detoxification.

qualifier: fructose and galactose with inherited enzyme defects
name: Fructose and galactose catabolism and inherited defects
rationale: Members are fructose and Leloir galactose catabolism, alditol metabolism and their inborn errors, distinguishing them from pentose phosphate, xylulose and glycerol confusables.

qualifier: triglyceride-rich chylomicron and VLDL lipolysis and clearance
name: Chylomicron and VLDL lipolytic remodeling and clearance
rationale: Members cover LPL/LIPC-mediated remodeling and clearance of chylomicrons and VLDL, unlike confusables centered on HDL/LDL remodeling, intestinal chylomicron assembly or LDL receptor endocytosis.

qualifier: invasion, phagosome maturation and xenophagy
name: Intracellular bacterial invasion, phagosome maturation and xenophagy
rationale: Members describe Listeria and Mycobacterium entry into host cells, pathogen subversion and host control of phagosome acidification, phagolysosome fusion and xenophagy, distinguishing them from viral, antimicrobial-peptide and toxin confusables.

qualifier: white adipocyte transcriptional program
name: Transcriptional control of white adipocyte differentiation
rationale: All members concern white fat cell differentiation and adipose development driven by PPARG-centered transcription, whereas confusables cover PPARA, PGC-1alpha, LXR and circadian nuclear-receptor metabolic regulation.

core: Antifungal C-type lectin and Th17 immunity
qualifier: IL-18, IL-36 and IL-38 cytokine signaling
name: Antifungal C-type lectin, Th17 and IL-18/IL-36 signaling
rationale: Members link Dectin-1/Dectin-2/DC-SIGN fungal recognition to IL-23/IL-17/Th17 responses and IL-1 family (IL-18, IL-36, IL-38) signaling; IL-18 distinguishes it from the IL-10/IL-12 confusable and the lectin members from IL-1 processing confusables.

qualifier: integrin-linked kinase adhesion cytoskeleton
name: Nuclear envelope remodeling and integrin-linked cytoskeletal adhesion
rationale: Members cover nuclear lamina/membrane disassembly and reassembly, nuclear positioning and enucleation together with ILK-PINCH-parvin focal adhesion, integrin signaling and actin capping, the latter absent from the ESCRT sealing, nuclear pore and cytokinesis confusables.

qualifier: axonemal dynein arms and mucociliary clearance
name: Motile cilium dynein arm assembly and mucociliary clearance
rationale: Members are inner/outer dynein arm assembly, motile cilium protein targeting and mucociliary clearance, distinguishing them from multiciliogenesis/ventricle and sperm flagellum confusables.

core: Receptor tyrosine kinase signaling to PI3K-AKT and ERK
qualifier: oncogenic fusions and amplifications
name: Oncogenic RTK fusion and amplification signaling via PI3K-AKT
rationale: Members are FGFR, PDGFR, FLT3, ALK/LTK and CSF1R signaling, mostly via cancer fusions and amplifications, feeding PI3K-AKT and ERK; confusables instead cover ligand-driven FGFR/ERBB/MET cascades, TKI-resistant point mutants or insulin signaling.

qualifier: spindle checkpoint and cytokinesis
name: Mitotic spindle assembly, checkpoint control and cytokinesis
rationale: Members span spindle formation and elongation, kinetochore attachment and spindle-checkpoint signaling, and Rho-driven cytokinesis, distinguishing them from sister-chromatid cohesion/centromere, APC/C and contractile-ring confusables.

qualifier: NADPH oxidase respiratory burst and hydrogen peroxide turnover
name: Phagocyte NADPH oxidase respiratory burst and peroxide regulation
rationale: Members regulate NADPH oxidase-driven respiratory burst, superoxide and hydrogen peroxide production and breakdown in phagocytes, which confusables on neutrophil degranulation, Fc/complement receptors and chemotaxis lack.

qualifier: insulin/IGF1 receptor-IRS input and its attenuation
name: Insulin/IGF1 receptor-IRS-PI3K-AKT signaling and attenuation
rationale: Members cover IRS/SHC/SOS signaling from insulin and IGF1 receptors to PI3K-AKT, its negative regulation and glycogen/glucose-uptake outputs, distinguishing them from GLUT4/adiponectin glucose-uptake confusables and oncogenic RTK signaling.

qualifier: nuclear phosphoinositides and PTEN regulation
name: Inositol pyrophosphate, nuclear phosphoinositide and PTEN regulation
rationale: Most members concern inositol (pyro)phosphate and nuclear phosphoinositide synthesis, pyrophosphate hydrolysis and PTEN localization/stability, which separates it from the AKT/PTEN loss-of-function confusables; a few protein (de)phosphorylation members are only loosely attached.
